{
  "dataset_name": "mozilla4",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "sqrt_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square root of the time duration between start and end, reducing the impact of extreme outliers.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1500.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smoothed, sub-linear scale for duration that helps linear SVMs establish more robust margins without being dominated by extreme values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.0, end - start))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed duration between start and end.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the wide range of durations into a compact scale, allowing the linear model to capture multiplicative differences as additive shifts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(0.0, end - start))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed size metric.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the heavily skewed size distribution, making it more suitable for linear decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size_per_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed ratio of size to duration, representing the rate of size accumulation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "rate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a continuous rate feature that can linearly separate instances based on their intensity or density over time.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size / np.maximum(1.0, end - start))"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_id",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Linearly scaled identifier, potentially capturing chronological or sequential data collection effects.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "metadata",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the SVM to linearly adjust for any underlying temporal drift or sequential bias in the dataset.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "id / 4088.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_size_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction term between the event flag and the log-transformed size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Enables the linear SVM to apply a different weight to the size feature depending on whether the event occurred.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * np.log1p(size)"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_start",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Start time normalized to a [0, 1] scale based on the maximum observed start time.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded, continuous temporal feature that prevents large raw timestamp values from dominating the SVM margin calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "start / 1936311.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_end",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "End time normalized to a [0, 1] scale based on the maximum observed end time.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded, continuous temporal feature for the completion time, suitable for linear scaling.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "end / 1965726.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_duration_size_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed ratio of duration to size, representing the time taken per unit of size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "rate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the inverse of the rate feature, providing an alternative linear projection that might better separate certain clusters.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(0.0, end - start) / np.maximum(1.0, size))"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_duration_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction term between the event flag and the log-transformed duration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to fit a specific slope for duration when the event flag is active, increasing model flexibility.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * np.log1p(np.maximum(0.0, end - start))"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_anomaly_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of whether the size is anomalously large or small given the event status and duration, scored from 0 (normal) to 1 (highly anomalous).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "anomaly",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a non-linear, context-aware anomaly score that can be directly used as a linear feature to penalize or highlight unusual instances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "temporal_progression_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the temporal progression and urgency based on start and end timestamps, scored from 0 (routine) to 1 (urgent/abnormal).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates complex temporal relationships into a single continuous severity measure, ideal for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
